newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee closes down in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee closes down in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.04 down in the kerb market at 39.22 to the dollar on Monday on slightly higher buying of the U.S. currency on fear of a further rupee depreciation by the central bank, dealers said.
"The rupee is likely to open lower on Tuesday," one dealer said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on August 29, was 35.6200/35.7981 to the dollar.
The premium on the foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 9.80 percent. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
